caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object resembling a candlestick holder, rendered in black and white pencil or charcoal on a light-colored paper. The object has a broad, circular base that narrows upward into a short stem before widening into a rounded, cylindrical body. The main body further narrows at the top and appears to have threads inside, suggesting it could hold a candle or other component. A curved handle attaches to the side of the body and extends outward and downward, ending in a small, knob-like terminal. The surface shows various highlights and shading to create a reflective, metallic appearance, with prominent light reflections running vertically along the main body and base. The artist's signature, "Eugene Barnett," is written in the bottom right corner. There are no other objects or background details in the composition.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
